intro: This page covers PHX’s official parking, with drive-up rates copied from the official Phoenix Sky Harbor rate table on November 27, 2026: the Terminal 3 and Terminal 4 garages ($33 per day), Sky Valet ($43) and reservation-only Premium ($37) in those garages, the West Economy Garage and East Economy Garages A & B ($19), the uncovered East Economy Lot and the 24th Street Station lot ($16), and the seasonal West Economy Park & Walk ($10). East Economy and 24th Street connect to the terminals by the free 24-hour PHX Sky Train; the West Economy options are a 12–15 minute walk with no shuttle. Below the official lots are nine off-airport options that publish their own pages: three The Parking Spot lots (two north of the airport, one south), Sky Harbor Airport Parking and PreFlight near 40th and 44th Streets, the two Airport Parking PHX lots on Van Buren (whose shuttle runs only 7 am–10 pm and only to the 44th Street Sky Train station), and two hotels whose own pages describe park-and-fly packages. It is not every lot near the airport, and PHX does not publish a list of authorized off-airport operators on the pages we checked. Rates are dated snapshots, not live quotes.

officialLots.access: Walk from the garage to Terminal 3

hours.notes: The official parking FAQ says PHX parking facilities are open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

officialLots.prebookRate: Online reservations available; the official page advertises “best available rates online” but does not publish a fixed prebook rate. Reservations carry a $2 non-refundable booking fee (as listed on 2026-11-27).
officialLots.rateNotes: Official drive-up rates as listed on 2026-11-27. PHX recommends parking in the garage nearest your airline’s terminal.
officialLots.visitNotes: Pay at the exit gate by cash or card, or at Pay on Foot machines. Level 1 has no cashier booths; cash must be paid at the Pay on Foot machines near the elevators.

listings.name: The Parking Spot 1
listings.area: E Washington St just west of S 40th St, between I-10 and SR-143, north of the airport; the operator says it is the closest off-airport facility (1.8 mi by its listing)

hours.notes: The operator’s PHX page says all three locations are open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year, with 24/7 shuttle service.

listings.shuttle: Free shuttle picks you up at your car; shuttles run every few minutes, 24/7, with typical rides of 3–4 minutes. Return pickup: Terminal 4 Door 7 (north curb); Terminal 3 Doors 9 or 11 at the blue Courtesy Vehicle sign. Live shuttle tracking in The Parking Spot app.
offers: Shuttle picks you up at your vehicle
Pay Later or Pay Now reservations
Spot Club loyalty program (members skip the reservation fee)
listings.visitNotes: Over 800 fully covered spaces, per the operator. No valet, EV charging, or car wash at PHX locations, per its FAQ. Pets must ride in a carrier on the shuttle. No cash accepted.
listings.feeNotes: The Parking Spot lists a standard $5.99 reservation fee (waived for Spot Club members) and says Pay Now reservations are non-refundable (as listed on 2026-11-27). Its FAQ cites rates starting around $11/day uncovered and $16/day covered when pre-booked; live prices vary by date.

listings.name: Sky Harbor Airport Parking
listings.area: S 40th St just south of Washington St, north of the airport; the operator says it is about 4 minutes from Terminal 4

hours.notes: The operator’s FAQ says it is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year.

listings.shuttle: Shuttle circulates to all terminals every 5–10 minutes (the home page says 7–10, the FAQ 5–7); drivers meet you at your vehicle within about 5 minutes of arrival and help with luggage.

listings.feeNotes: The FAQ says cancelled reservations are fully refundable. Rates are on the reservation page and not copied here.

listings.name: PreFlight Airport Parking PHX
listings.area: N 44th St just north of Washington St, near the 44th Street PHX Sky Train station

hours.notes: The location page does not state facility hours. It says buses arrive at both terminals every 5–9 minutes during regular hours, and that for airport pickups between 11 p.m. and 8 a.m. you should text or call 480-925-9630 with your party size and terminal.

listings.shuttle: Free shuttle every 7–10 minutes with real-time tracking; 7–15 minute ride (the page also says 4–7 minutes). Return pickup: Terminal 3 north side, Door 11, outer curb; Terminal 4 north side, Door 7, outer curb, at the Courtesy Vehicle sign. Wheelchair-accessible shuttle on 24 hours’ notice.
offers: Outdoor self-park (uncovered and carport spaces, first come)
Free tire inflation and battery jump
EV charging via 120V outlets (bring your own charger)
listings.visitNotes: Three-story garage plus an outdoor section. The page posted a construction notice that Terminal 3 was closed to pickups and drop-offs 10 p.m.–6 a.m. through at least November 15, with shuttles serving Terminal 4 only in those hours; check whether that still applies. EV charging is a 120V outlet based on availability.
listings.feeNotes: The page says cancellations made at least one hour before the start time are refunded less the reservation fee, unused days are non-refundable, and cash is not accepted for payment. Rates are not copied here.
